visual_comparison.method: Direct sRGB metrics over rows 260 through 719 of matched 1280x720 breaking_water_side gameplay captures. Luminance is Rec.709-weighted sRGB; highlight fractions use normalized thresholds 0.90 and 0.95.
visual_comparison.verdict: Retain the corrected Futaleufu bracket: clipped >0.95 coverage falls 98.20 percent, p95 falls 1.26 percent, and cold blue-minus-red separation rises 29.79 percent without a Chilko control regression. The broad pale water body, limited crest breakup, and procedural environment remain visibly non-photoreal.
